Algebra 2 · Unit 3: Linear Systems and Matrices

Three-Variable Systems

Solve systems of three linear equations in three unknowns.

What you’ll learn

  • Reduce a three-variable system to two variables
  • Solve three-variable systems
  • Model situations with three unknowns
  • Write a system as an augmented matrix
  • Use row operations (Gaussian elimination) to solve a system

The mountain biking connection

Add rock gardens and soil loads to the berm-and-jump plan: three features, three resources, three equations.

Learning activities

Interactive lab · from Algebra 2: Systems of Equations

Bike Park Blueprint Lab

Design a bike park with a trail crew: solve two- and three-variable systems for the build plan, run Gaussian elimination in a row-operation console, cost the whole park with matrix multiplication, and solve AX = B with an inverse.

Level
Intermediate to Advanced
Time
20-25 min
  • 4 missions
  • Blueprint graph
  • Matrix elimination console
  • Matrix cost calculator
  • Matrix equation solver
  • Final Build Plan (10)
  • Optional park optimizer

Practises here: Model situations with three unknowns; Solve three-variable systems; Reduce a three-variable system to two variables; Write a system as an augmented matrix; Use row operations (Gaussian elimination) to solve a system
